sections.shortTitle: Oil and Gas Development Corporation Third Amendment Ordinance 1996
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE CIV OF 1996
ORDINANCE CIV OF 1996
OIL AND GAS DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (THIRD
AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance further to amend the Oil and Gas
Development Corporation Ordinance, 1961
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
2nd November, 1996]
No. F.2(1)/96‑Pub., dated 2‑11‑1996.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to amend the
oil and Gas Development Corporation Ordinance, 1961 (XXXVII of 1961), for the
purpose hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is not in
session and the President is satisfied that the circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may
be called the oil and Gas Development Corporation (Third Amendment) Ordinance,
1996.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

sections.description:
Substitution of section 31, Ordinance XXXVII of 1961

ORDINANCE CIV OF 1996
ORDINANCE CIV OF 1996
OIL AND GAS DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (THIRD
AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance further to amend the Oil and Gas
Development Corporation Ordinance, 1961
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
2nd November, 1996]
No. F.2(1)/96‑Pub., dated 2‑11‑1996.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to amend the
oil and Gas Development Corporation Ordinance, 1961 (XXXVII of 1961), for the
purpose hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is not in
session and the President is satisfied that the circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
2. Substitution of section 31, Ordinance XXXVII
of 1961.‑‑In
the Oil and Gas Development Corporation Ordinance, 1961 (XXXVII of 1961), for
section 31 the following shall be substituted, namely:‑‑
"31. Conversion of Corporation into a
Limited Company.‑‑(1) Notwithstanding anything contained
hereinbefore the Federal Government may, whenever it deems expedient cause the
Corporation to be incorporated under the Companies Ordinance, 1984 (XLVII of
1984), as a company limited by shares.
(2) All assets, properties, installations,
plants, machinery, rights and liabilities of the Corporation shall on
incorporation of the company under subsection (1), stand transferred to that
company and all unexpended funds and appropriations of the Corporations shall
be available to be expended by the company in exercise of the powers, authority
and duties conferred on it by its Memorandum and Articles of Association.
(3) All contracts made, licences or concessions
issued and all liabilities incurred by the Corporation shall on incorporation
of the company under subsection (1) shall be deemed to be made, issued or
incurred by the company and shall be enforceable accordingly.
(4) All employees of the Corporation shall
stand transferred to the company incorporated under subsection (1) on the same
terms and conditions of employment as were applicable to them immediately
before the incorporation of the company under subsection (1).
(5) On incorporation of the Corporation into a
limited company under subsection (1), the Corporation shall cease to
exist."
